selection_basis: 94 original output_clips MP4s; pilot: 6 per AGE group, historical cases plus temporal spread and short/long clips. No sports scores used. Midpoint contact sheet reviewed; no complete manual identity annotation.
limitations: Same competition/capture family; no claim of cross-camera or cross-event generalization
Clips can share athletes or overlap in source time; no train/test split is asserted
Container metadata is provisional; runner verifies each selected video with ffprobe and decoding
Broadcast black bars and graphics retained; no automatic ROI cropping
No independent identity ground truth supplied
